verdict.rationale: Any web-facing service could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an llms.txt file or agent-oriented documentation. The probes found ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning HTTP 403 at robots.txt, and the remaining items are ordinary human-facing portal and tax pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
